description: volume_bisect catch-all — matches ANY imageGroupNumber (predicate '~' = empty-substring match) so a bisect not covered by a more specific fixture degrades into the tool's own inconclusive stop instead of aborting the run with unmatched_tool_call. Mirrors image-search-any. Order it LAST among volume-bisect fixtures. Added when search-images gained volume_bisect (#3549): every test that runs search-images live must stock each of its tools.

response.stopped: 3 consecutive probes found no year (covers, blank leaves or target cards). Stopping rather than walking the volume a page at a time.
